quests.title: Nationalism Historian Quest
quests.description: Explore the rise of nationalism in Europe and India through historical analysis!

story.introduction: Travel through the 19th and 20th centuries to witness the rise of nationalism. Understand how nations were born and freedom was won!

steps.title: European Nationalism Study
steps.narrative: Professor History takes you to 19th century Europe. Observe how nationalism shaped modern nations.

problem.question: What role did the French Revolution play in spreading nationalism in Europe?
problem.sample_answer: The French Revolution introduced ideas of liberty, equality, and fraternity, which inspired nationalist movements across Europe...
problem.explanation: Students should explain how revolutionary ideas spread and inspired other European nations to seek independence and unification.
